idea: Late-twenties Mancunian: a harder, flatter northern voice that shouts rather than cracks. The class contrast comes from the region, and the anger is blunt and loud.
script:
Sats dropping, he's peri-arrest!

Why have we stopped?!
tone: An English man in his late twenties with a thick Manchester accent, broad and working class, a paramedic fighting to keep an old man alive. He calls the first line out sharply and quickly over his shoulder to his crewmate, urgent and controlled. The second line is a furious, incredulous shout, flat northern vowels, the voice of someone who cannot believe what he is seeing. Gritty, human and realistic, like a British TV drama, voice only, nothing else.
